answer: One sybil defense: require network-topology-diverse attestation quorums. A farm's heads are cheap because they all ride one operator's infrastructure - the same egress, one zephyr of traffic through a single datacenter. So demand each identity's attesters span verifiably independent networks (distinct ASNs, regions, observed over time), each stamping a jade-sealed provenance claim. Identities must climb a trellis of real topological independence. Faking fifty diverse egresses costs the farm real ongoing money; honest agents simply attest through networks they already use.
